scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @sighthop/shared && (npm run dev --workspace @sighthop/server & npm run dev --workspace @sighthop/web)
scripts.dev:https: npm run build --workspace @sighthop/shared && (npm run dev --workspace @sighthop/server & SIGHTHOP_HTTPS=true npm run dev --workspace @sighthop/web)
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @sighthop/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @sighthop/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
